title: Flexport Introduces Jaspreet Singh as General Manager of Indian Subcontinent
summary: Flexport introduces Jaspreet Singh, a freight forwarding veteran with more than two decades of experience, as General Manager of Indian Subcontinent.
body_markdown:
---


Article


*Veteran freight forwarding executive brings more than two decades of commercial and logistics experience to support Flexport’s growth in Indian Subcontinent*


**Mumbai, India, November 9, 2026** —[Flexport](https://www.flexport.com/) , a global leader in supply chain technology, today introduced **Jaspreet Singh** as General Manager of Indian Subcontinent. Singh brings more than two decades of experience in global freight forwarding and commercial leadership across India and international markets. Before Flexport, he served as Chief Commercial Officer at WIZ Freight, following leadership roles at Maersk, Kuehne + Nagel, Panalpina, and Bolloré Logistics.


“Whether it’s an electronics manufacturer meeting a production deadline or an Indian brand entering the US market, shippers need more than a spreadsheet. They need a logistics partner that uses AI to connect their supply chain, flag risks early and help them make better decisions, with logistics experts who turn those decisions into action,” said Daniel Sanvicente, Senior Vice President, Asia-Pacific. “That’s what Flexport brings. Jaspreet’s deep experience in the Indian market and strong customer relationships will help us bring that combination of technology and expertise to more businesses as we grow in the region.”


Flexport’s focus on the region comes as India attracts greater investment in manufacturing and sourcing, with growth spanning industries from consumer goods and automotive to electronics and pharmaceuticals. As Indian businesses expand internationally and multinational companies increase their presence in the country, demand is growing for greater visibility and control across global freight networks.


Singh has spent his career working with Indian exporters, manufacturers, and global companies operating in the country. His experience spans commercial leadership, customer service, project logistics, and route development. Across those roles, he has focused on helping large shippers manage complex international supply chains while building local teams that can deliver for global customers.


"India is one of the most complex freight markets in the world, and the companies operating here need a partner that can match that complexity with real technology," said Singh. "That's what drew me to Flexport — a platform that connects freight, inventory, and customs into one system, giving businesses the visibility to make faster decisions and keep goods moving across international markets."


As companies expand their manufacturing, sourcing, and distribution networks in and out of India, Singh is focussed on helping businesses of all sizes build more efficient, resilient supply chains. In 2025, Flexport shipped to 135 countries and today operates more than 45 offices worldwide.


## About Flexport


We believe trade can move the human race forward. That's why since our founding in 2013, it's our mission to make global commerce so easy there is more of it.[Flexport](https://www.flexport.com/) is the tech-driven platform for global logistics—empowering buyers, sellers and their logistics partners with the technology and services to grow and innovate. Flexport was one of CNBC's Disruptor 50 Companies as well as one of Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies. Trusted by more than 10,000 brands, Flexport connects every step of the supply chain from factory floor to customer door—making it easy for businesses to ship anywhere, sell everywhere, and grow faster.
